[Act: income-tax-2025
 Chapter: Return of Income
 Section: 265::Return by whom to be verified.
]

The return of income under section 263 required to be furnished by the person specified in column B of the Table below shall be verified by the person specified in corresponding entry in column C of the said Table:

(ii) by the principal officer of the association. 13. Any other person. (i) By the person himself; or
  (ii) by any person competent to act on his behalf.

metadata.section_title: Return by whom to be verified.
